gloss: to install; to set up; to fix in place

definitions.gloss: to install; to set up; to fix in place
definitions.explanation: To permanently place or mount equipment, machinery, or fixtures in a fixed position.

examples.japanese: エアコンを{据|す}え{付|つ}ける。
{新|あたら}しい{機械|きかい}を{工場|こうじょう}に{据|す}え{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: We installed new machinery in the factory.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}に{大|おお}きな{石灯籠|いしどうろう}を{据|す}え{付|つ}けるのに{半日|はんにち}かかった。
examples.english: It took half a day to set up the large stone lantern in the garden.

notes:
A compound verb of {据|す}える (to set, to place) and {付|つ}ける (to attach). Describes the permanent installation or mounting of something heavy or fixed, as opposed to simply placing a portable item.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive. The intransitive counterpart is {据|す}え{付|つ}く, though it is rarely used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- エアコンを{据|す}え{付|つ}ける — to install an air conditioner
- {機械|きかい}を{据|す}え{付|つ}ける — to install machinery
- {据|す}え{付|つ}け{工事|こうじ} — installation work
- {据|す}え{付|つ}け{型|がた} — built-in type, fixed type

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {設置|せっち}する — to set up, to install (more formal/official)
- {取|と}り{付|つ}ける — to attach, to install (broader usage, including smaller items)
